about_the_game:
About This Game

Deliver the goods. Dodge the monster.

Goblita’s Delivery Service is a chaotic co-op horror game where up to four goblin girls battle tight deadlines, creepy back alleys, cursed kitchens, and an ever-stalking monster... all in the name of hot, fresh pizza.

Deliver or Die

You’ve got 10 minutes to get that Delivery to the customer  If you take too long, you die

🧢 Customize Your Courier

Each goblin can equip hats, boots, and backpacks that change their perks, powers, and delivery style. Want to hover over traffic? Reheat with a microwave pack? Taunt the monster with your voice? Build your loadout — and your look.

👹 The Monster Hears Everything

The creature in the shadows isn't scripted. It listens, it learns, and it hunts based on noise, fear, and scent. Make the wrong move (or step on the wrong squeaky boot), and it might just end your Delivery.

🧠 Easy to Learn, Greasy to Master

🔥 Key Features

  • 1–4 Player Online Co-op Chaos

  • Hot & Cold Pizza Delivery Mechanics

  •  Perk-Based Loadout System (Hats, Boots, Backpacks)

  •  Dynamic Monster AI with Fear-Based Sensing

  •  Steam Workshop Support (Maps, Perks, Cosmetics)

  •  Proximity Voice Chat + Taunt System

  •  Steam Inventory & Trading Integration

  •  Freeze-Frame Death Cams. Expressive Animations. Very Small Goblins.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: 3ghz or faster processor
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 650 or Radeon HD 7770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: -d3d11 in steam launch options
